name: session-restore
description: Reopens Claude Code sessions that a crash, restart or closed terminal cut off

shell.title: Shell for restored tabs
shell.description: What each restored tab leaves you in when claude exits. none closes the tab with claude. On macOS and Linux, any value but none leaves your login shell.

terminal.title: Terminal for restored sessions (macOS, Linux)
terminal.description: auto: tmux inside tmux, Terminal or iTerm2 on macOS, the first installed desktop terminal on Linux. print: show the commands instead. Windows always uses Windows Terminal.
